sources.entry: Claper - The ultimate tool to interact with your audience (alternative to Slido, AhaSlides and Mentimeter). (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Elixir/Docker

summary.one_liner: Claper is a self-hostable audience interaction tool that adds Q&A, polls, quizzes, forms, live captions and reactions to existing PDF or PowerPoint slides.
summary.what_it_does: Attendees join from their phone via QR code or event code, with no app or account required. Presenters upload PDF, PPT or PPTX decks and attach polls, quizzes, feedback forms, web embeds and live captions to slides. Audience questions, messages and reactions appear live on the slides and in a presenter view, with moderation tools such as pinning, banning and deleting messages. Results, messages and transcripts can be exported as CSV. The README also describes LTI 1.3 LMS integration with Moodle, quiz export in QTI format, SSO via OpenID Connect, and an admin panel.
use_cases: run live Q&A during a presentation
create interactive polls and quizzes for slides
collect audience feedback forms at events
self-host an alternative to Slido or Mentimeter
add live captions and transcripts to talks
send quiz scores to a Moodle gradebook
how_to_run: Sign in with admin@claper.co / claper and change the password immediately
notable: Works with existing PDF or PowerPoint decks rather than requiring a new slide editor
Audience joins with no app or account
LTI 1.3 integration with Moodle and quiz scores returned to the LMS gradebook
SSO with any OpenID Connect provider, or SSO-only mode
caveats: Live captions require the user's own Mistral API key
Cloud tier is free only up to 10 attendees, then paid per event
Default admin credentials must be changed after first login; BASE_URL and HTTPS are needed for public deployment
